name: Exp_LSMA_Angle
summary: This EA trades based on the LSMA (Least Squares Moving Average) Angle indicator, opening buy positions when the angle crosses upward above threshold and sell positions when it crosses downward. It uses a custom indicator handle to read angle values (0-4 scale) and generates signals on new bar formation, with configurable money management and separate open/close controls for long and short positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于LSMA（最小二乘移动平均线）角度指标进行交易，当角度向上突破阈值时开多仓，向下突破时开空仓。它通过自定义指标句柄读取角度值（0-4标度），在新K线形成时生成信号，并具有可配置的资金管理和多空独立开关控制。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是基于最小二乘移动平均线（LSMA）的斜率角度来判断趋势方向和强度。入场条件为：当指标值从4以下突破到4时开多仓（上升趋势确立），当指标值从0以上跌破到0时开空仓（下降趋势确立）。出场条件为：当多头指标值低于2时平多仓，当空头指标值高于1时平空仓。仓位管理依赖于TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数，支持多种资金管理模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损后余额/保证金、固定手数）。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode选择计算模式，止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险收益比为1:2。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is based on the slope angle of the Least Squares Moving Average (LSMA) to determine trend direction and strength. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator value crosses up to 4 (uptrend confirmed), and a sell position is opened when the indicator value crosses down to 0 (downtrend confirmed). Exit conditions: long positions are closed when the indicator value drops below 2, and short positions are closed when the indicator value rises above 1. Position sizing relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library's BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions, supporting multiple money management modes including free margin, balance, loss-adjusted balance/margin, and fixed lot. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode for calculation mode, with a 1000-point stop loss, 2000-point take profit, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling position size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (fixed lot or margin ratio)

pros: 使用LSMA角度判断趋势，相比简单均线交叉减少了滞后性
多空方向独立开关控制，灵活适应不同行情
支持多种资金管理模式，适应不同风险偏好
pros_en: Uses LSMA angle for trend detection, reducing lag compared to simple MA crossovers
Independent buy/sell open/close switches provide flexible market adaptation
Supports multiple money management modes catering to different risk preferences
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标LSMA_Angle，若指标缺失则EA无法运行
止损1000点过大，在波动较大的品种上可能导致较大亏损
缺乏点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator LSMA_Angle; EA fails if indicator is missing
1000-point stop loss is very wide, potentially causing large losses on volatile instruments
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, may open positions under unfavorable conditions
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差和低流动性时段交易
将止损止盈参数优化为ATR动态计算，而非固定点数
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during high spread and low liquidity periods
Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic calculation for better market adaptation

risk_points: 止损点数固定为1000点，未根据品种波动率动态调整，可能过大或过小
缺乏点差过滤机制，在流动性不足时可能以较高滑点成交
risk_points_en: Fixed 1000-point stop loss does not adapt to instrument volatility, potentially too wide or too narrow
No spread filter mechanism, may execute at high slippage during low liquidity
